aws_db_instance.tomb:
resource "aws_db_instance" "tomb" {
  identifier                  = "haunted-tomb"
  engine                      = "postgres"
  engine_version              = "16"
  instance_class              = "db.t3.micro"
  allocated_storage           = 20
  username                    = "tomb_admin"
  manage_master_user_password = true
  db_subnet_group_name        = aws_db_subnet_group.tomb.name
  vpc_security_group_ids      = [aws_security_group.tomb_ward.id]
  publicly_accessible         = false
  storage_encrypted           = true
  skip_final_snapshot         = true
}
aws_vpc_security_group_ingress_rule.mans:
resource "aws_vpc_security_group_ingress_rule" "mansion_ssh" {
  security_group_id = aws_security_group.mansion_gate.id
  cidr_ipv4         = "0.0.0.0/0"
  from_port         = 22
  to_port           = 22
  ip_protocol       = "tcp"
}

resource "aws_vpc_security_group_ingress_rule" "mansion_http" {
  security_group_id = aws_security_group.mansion_gate.id
  cidr_ipv4         = "0.0.0.0/0"
  from_port         = 80
  to_port           = 80
  ip_protocol       = "tcp"
}
aws_vpc_security_group_ingress_rule.tomb:
resource "aws_vpc_security_group_ingress_rule" "tomb_from_mansion" {
  security_group_id            = aws_security_group.tomb_ward.id
  referenced_security_group_id = aws_security_group.mansion_gate.id
  from_port                    = 5432
  to_port                      = 5432
  ip_protocol                  = "tcp"
}
aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block.crypt:
resource "aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block" "crypt" {
  bucket = aws_s3_bucket.crypt.id

  block_public_acls       = false
  block_public_policy     = false
  ignore_public_acls      = false
  restrict_public_buckets = false
}
